svg.title: dsh-site-log-check three evidence swimlanes
svg.desc: Three material surfaces stacked as swimlanes over one service-period day ruler. Lane A holds logs[] and the SL-001 / SL-002 / SL-003…SL-007 gates; two logs on 2026-03-01 and four hollow calendar days are drawn from the quickstart sample. Lane B holds keyWorks[] with SL-008 and SL-012. Lane C holds the onsite[] record shape and SL-009 / SL-010 / SL-011 / SL-014. Two cross-lane bridges carry SL-012 (key work name match) and SL-013 (a log's on-site claim to the same-day record). The lanes aggregate into issues[] and skipped[]. The run strip quotes the quickstart result: 0 error, 1 warn, 4 info, 12 skipped; skipped splits into 7 checks that could not run and 5 that ran without a difference but are still listed.

text.font-family: Consolas,'Microsoft YaHei',ui-monospace,monospace
'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
